title: Note Service Cap Table by Marlowe & Finch Card Spend — Merchandise Purchases
content:
**Cap rule.** On a refund of a Finch Note left undeducted on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a customer whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to a Marlowe & Finch card in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchases whose transaction date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reach the upper note card-spend threshold of $2000.00 has the upper note service cap of $12.00; one whose such purchases reach the middle note card-spend threshold of $750.00 but not the upper has the middle note service cap of $6.00. A customer whose such purchases total less than $750.00 is outside this rule.

The purchases are read from the purchase transactions at Marlowe & Finch on the customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts.

| Card purchases at Marlowe & Finch, past twelve months (hypothetical) | Note service cap |
|---|---|
| $2000.00 | $12.00 |
| $1999.99 | $6.00 |
| $750.00 | $6.00 |
| $749.99 | outside this rule |
